notes.notes: [h1]Demo Version 0.5.1 (patch)[/h1][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed 'mouse aim/sensitivity' issues when using very low 'look sensitivity' in-game setting combined with high mouse DPI value[/b] (this caused extremely bloated aiming with the mouse - it was such an edge case that I eventually got tired of hunting it down)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tweaked gamepad stick behavior[/b] (this one's a bit tricky, Xbox controllers (xinput) might occasionally act up, but PS4 (DirectInput) controllers seem to work without any phantom stick input; if anyone reading this, please drop me some feedback about gameplay with controller, otherwise I'm just gonna blame Unity6 and not my coding skills :D)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bumped up player movement speed slightly;[/b] still maybe slow though, it's survival horror after all (this change is meant to prepare for upcoming game levels and some future enemies - a few of them will be quicker than what you see in the current demo)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted weapon recoil (again!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Thanks again to everyone who tried the demo ːsteamthumbsupː[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Some dev news:[/b] the key rebinding feature is in the works, so it'll actually make it into the release!
